method: Static decompilation of eight handlers in pinned ELF. Lengths count request bytes including 80 28 00 and selector, and response bytes including completion and echoed IANA. Null means not proved; minimum_read_bytes is a static memory-access bound, not a validated wire length. No live selector execution is claimed.

shared.short_request_code: C7 where the handler checks for fewer than four bytes; F8 does not perform this check
shared.bad_iana_code: CC where the handler calls IsIANAPresent; F8 does not call it
shared.normal_response: completion byte, echoed IANA, then selector-specific bytes
shared.dispatch_source: boxes/irmc-fujitsu/evidence/irmc-s6-command-tables.tsv, g_OEM_CmdHndlr rows 133-140; duplicate MSMM callback rows 16-23
shared.activation: Registered in both normal and MSMM tables; platform/runtime feature gates are identified per selector. Table privilege is the minimum admission privilege, not a proof of leaf authorization.

f8.shared_gate: utIsBladeSystem() must be true, else C1; unlike SCCI handlers this function does not check IANA or a four-byte minimum before reading selector

04.name: NVRAM/IDPROM maintenance multiplexer

request.accepted_total_bytes: 5..9 regardless of helper subcommand; wrapper checks only total-5<5
request.minimum_read_bytes: 5 for most subcommands; 9 for DF, which loads a 32-bit value at byte5 without a matching wrapper length check
request.fields: byte4 helper subcommand. DE selects five output bytes; other subcommands select one. DF consumes bytes5-8 as a 32-bit flags value. Additional bytes are ignored by most subcommands

response.success_total_bytes: 5 for subcommands other than DE; 9 for DE
response.fields: completion is CheckNvramToIdprom return; bytes4.. are helper output initialized to zero and selectively overwritten, not a uniform comparison result

04.effect: mixed; many subcommands mutate persistent NVRAM, IDPROM, FRU, or BMC state. Examples: A3 backup; C0/C1 restore; D0-DD and DF alter flags; E3 writes IDPROM; EA clears IDPROM/FRU; F6 restores NVRAM. Treat the entire parent selector as unsafe
04.completion_codes: 00/01 common; other backend low-byte completion values unresolved, C7 wrapper length, CC bad IANA
04.activation: CheckNvramToIdprom in SHA-pinned libfts_util.so.1.30.73; no live subcommand probe
04.evidence: wrapper OEM_FTS_SCCI_CS_Cmds@0x33f2c case 04; helper CheckNvramToIdprom@0x8fb90: subcommand switch, DF 32-bit load, C0/C1/E3/EA/F6 persistent operations
